title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Metals-led selloff, oil the lone bid.
A hawkish 100% October hike odds collided with a 3.5% CPI, sending silver -4.23%, gold -1.80% and long bonds lower, while oil's +3.30% kept energy the sole green sector. Money left SPY (-$13.0bn) and IWM (-$3.3bn) 5d but crowded into SOXX (+$1.8bn, 100th pctile) — a narrow real-asset and semis trade, not a broad one.

INDICES — VIX 14.2, below its 15.6 20-day MA, complacent.
SOXX -1.23%, SPY -0.72%, DIA -0.71%, QQQ -0.84%, IWM -1.84%; QQQ actually -0.84% ranks above IWM. Large > small by 0.40pp. Best-to-worst: SOXX -1.23% did trail QQQ, so order is QQQ -0.84%, SPY -0.72%, DIA -0.71%, SOXX -1.23%, IWM -1.84%. Notably TLT -1.58% and USO +3.30% were the biggest cross-asset moves.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.3x on a -0.72% close = distribution; QQQ lighter, no ratio given as elevated. SOXX 1.4x, IJH 1.4x gaining attention; SLV 0.9x, GLD 0.7x ignored. Breadth diverges hard: only 28% above 50-DMA, 47% above 200-DMA, adv/dec 173/327, up/down vol 0.47, new 60d highs/lows 14/102. Participation diverges — narrow mega-cap tape.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +0.96%, XLI Industrials -0.10%, XLP Staples -0.36%, XLK Technology -0.47%, XLF Financials -0.47%, XLB Materials -0.49%, XLV Healthcare -0.64%, XLC Comms -0.85%, XLY Discretionary -1.50%, XLRE Real Estate -1.55%, XLU Utilities -1.92%.
Top industries USO +3.30%, MSOS +1.88%; bottom SILJ -5.44%, GDX -4.36%. Flows contradict price: XLY +$711mm (100th pctile) and XLK +$147mm lead inflows while XLF -$2,305mm (0p) and XLV -$1,089mm (2p) bleed. Money in energy/semis, out of financials/healthcare — defensive risk-off with an oil kicker.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR_vol 1.27 and SPY 1.13 signal real protection demand; IWM 0.22 is the outlier. Positive skew (SPY +3.7%, QQQ +6.1%) = put premium = fear. VIXEQ 39.2 vs VIX 14.2 is a historically wide gap — high dispersion, stock-picker's tape, not macro-correlated.

CROSS-ASSET — Dollar +0.60% pressured gold -1.80% and silver -4.23%; rising yields (TLT -1.58%, IEF -1.06%) hit real assets hardest. Oil +3.30% with 20d +17.98% is the standout inflation signal. Next FOMC Oct 28: CME FedWatch prices hike 100.0%; Polymarket shows 64% for a 25bp hike, +10pp in 5 days, with no-change at 34% (-9pp).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 50.3, Neutral. Movers: PANW +5.00%, WPM -5.44%, PAAS -5.39%. Vol spikes: UNG 2.8x flat, FNGS 2.1x flat — neither confirms accumulation. Momentum extremes: XLK +7.48% 20d best sector, XLU -8.22% worst. Watch: IWM -1.84% (Russell 2000 breadth 28% above 50-DMA, 20d -5.78%), SLV -4.23% (IV 30.8%, 20d -6.68%, silver leading the metals break), XLE +0.96% (only sector green against a -4.36% GDX, oil 20d +17.98%).
